annotations.title: A vault’s tokenized stocks and stablecoins

description: What one vault holds in real-world assets: tokenized stocks it holds at its own address, what it has lent against tokenized stocks as collateral (exposure through borrowers, not stocks it owns), and whether its own asset is a stablecoin. Free. Holdings come from the registers we rebuild for the largest stock tokens; anything outside them is not seen, not absent.
